target_qa_variants.question: Ni kwa mfumo gani wa upigaji kura ambapo majimbo ya mwakilishi mmoja nchini Singapore humchagua mbunge mmoja?

target_qa_variants.source_span: Each SMC returns one MP by first-past-the-post voting
target_qa_variants.translation_note: Translated 'first-past-the-post' to 'mfumo wa kura nyingi' (plurality system), which is the standard Swahili equivalent for this electoral system.
